name: galaxz-debounce
status: TESTING (Galax-z v1, on the author's unit by choice 2026-11-21, boots): placeholder values (+15) until the key test's report gives real ones; the unit (ms) is not confirmed
description: Raise the debounce the OS asks the keyboard chip for, to stop keys double-triggering. See notes/debounce.md.

edits.evidence: [code] 'R1 = 35' feeding the call to set-button-debounce 0x80131700 (command_handler_kb.cpp, logs 'Set button debounce: %d'); notes/debounce.md
[code] 'R1 = 30' feeding the call to set-button-debounce 0x80131700 (command_handler_kb.cpp, logs 'Set button debounce: %d'); notes/debounce.md

edits.what: debounce sent (when the sound byte is over 30): 50 -> 63
edits.evidence: [code] 'R0 = 50' feeding the call to set-button-debounce 0x80131700 (command_handler_kb.cpp, logs 'Set button debounce: %d'); notes/debounce.md
[code] 'R1 = 35' feeding the call to set-button-debounce 0x80131700 (command_handler_kb.cpp, logs 'Set button debounce: %d'); notes/debounce.md
[code] 'R1 = 30' feeding the call to set-button-debounce 0x80131700 (command_handler_kb.cpp, logs 'Set button debounce: %d'); notes/debounce.md

revert: Write back the original os.ldr and os.crc32 in update mode, or reinstall TE's official 1.2.45 (Firmware/README.md).
risk: Too high a value swallows fast repeated presses of one key; check with Galax-z's key test after installing. The threshold at 0x8010dcde is not touched.
